title: Operating a shared stash
text: number processes can read , never wait: read sees last committed state. Writes take turns. write waits longer timeout seconds (60 default) another process’s write raises dastash_busy, hang. process opens stash . handle carried forked child, parallel::mclapply() worker. Using raises dastash_forked, open stash inside worker: Workers started fresh processes (‘callr’, ‘mirai’, ‘future’ multisession) nothing inherit, open stash like process. Every single operation atomic across processes. Eight processes calling stash_incr() one key count eight. stash_add() writes entry. stash_pop() reads deletes one step.
code: parallel::mclapply(keys, function(k) {   s <- stash(dir)   on.exit(stash_close(s))   stash_get(s, k, default = NULL) }) stash_incr(s, "jobs-run") #> [1] 1 stash_add(s, "lock/nightly", Sys.getpid(), expire = 3600) #> [1] TRUE stash_add(s, "lock/nightly", Sys.getpid()) #> [1] FALSE

title: Operating a shared stash
text: stash_transact() makes block writes atomic: commit, none . holds write lock runs, processes’ writes wait . Keep short, never compute something slow inside . also fastest way write many entries: making write durable expensive part, transaction pays . Memoised functions follow rule. Two processes miss call moment compute , one result kept. duplicated work, never wrong answer.
code: stash_set(s, "balance", 100) stash_transact(s, {   stash_set(s, "balance", stash_get(s, "balance") - 30)   stash_incr(s, "withdrawals") }) #> [1] 1 stash_get(s, "balance") #> [1] 70

title: Operating a shared stash
text: default (durability = "safe") every write disk returns. durability = "fast" skips waiting disk: crash machine can lose recent writes, never damages stash. "unsafe" can damage , stashes can rebuild. first process open stash sets every process opens open; stash_stats() reports force.
code: stash_stats(s)$durability #> [1] "safe"

title: Operating a shared stash
text: size_limit bounds entries hold. write goes evicts least recently stored entries, time, limit holds without background process. stash_cull() finishes job . Expired entries go first. database file keeps pages frees reuse rather shrinking, stash_volume(), reports bytes disk, can stay limit.
code: for (i in 1:5) stash_set(s, paste0("frame/", i), runif(5e4)) stash_count(s) #> [1] 2 stash_cull(s) stash_count(s) #> [1] 2

title: Operating a shared stash
text: process dies middle write can leave, , file nothing refers . stash_check() finds , damage. repair = TRUE fixes , hash = TRUE also verifies every stored file’s content. Run now maintenance job, stash_cull().

code: library(dastash)  s <- stash(file.path(tempdir(), "prices"))  # Keys map to values, with expiry and tags. s |> stash_set("XSWX/2026-08-29", c(101.2, 101.9), expire = 3600, tags = "XSWX") stash_get(s, "XSWX/2026-08-29") #> [1] 101.2 101.9 stash_get(s, "missing", default = NULL) #> NULL  # A key can be any combination of values; field order does not matter. stash_set(s, list(exchange = "XSWX", date = as.Date("2026-08-29")), "quotes") stash_get(s, list(date = as.Date("2026-08-29"), exchange = "XSWX")) #> [1] "quotes"  # A function, cached across sessions and processes. slow_square <- function(x) {   Sys.sleep(1)   x^2 } square <- stash_memoise(slow_square, s) system.time(square(12)) #>    user  system elapsed  #>   0.003   0.000   1.034 system.time(square(12)) #>    user  system elapsed  #>   0.000   0.000   0.001  # The catalogue is a data frame. stash_entries(s)[, c("key", "bytes", "codec", "expires")] #>                                   key bytes codec             expires #> 1                     XSWX/2026-08-29    47   rds 2026-09-29 19:59:14 #> 2             slow_square/v1/{x=i:12}    39   rds                <NA> #> 3 {date=d:2026-08-29,exchange=s:XSWX}     6   raw                <NA>  stash_close(s)

title: dastash 0.1.0
text: Initial CRAN submission. persistent cache shared every R process machine: stash() opens directory; stash_get(), stash_set(), stash_has(), stash_delete(), stash_mget() stash_mset() read write ; stash_keys(), stash_entries(), stash_count(), stash_volume() stash_stats() describe . Keys text, R value specified key encoding covers (stash_key()), cache keyed function arguments survives R upgrades. Small values live transactional ‘libmdbx’ database ‘mdbx’; values inline_max bytes become read-, content-addressed files, stored however many keys hold (stash_path()). Entries expire (expire =, stash_expire()), carry tags (stash_evict(tag =)), evicted least-recently-stored first cache holds size_limit (stash_cull()). Atomic operations across processes: stash_add(), stash_pop(), stash_touch(), stash_incr(), stash_decr() stash_transact(). stash_memoise() caches function’s results across sessions processes; as_cachem() lets ‘memoise’ ‘shiny’ use stash. stash_check() finds repairs damage, reclaims crash leaves.
